text:
emma-ops: Quick notice 12 Polaris P850 dedicated preview pools will open a limited validation window in singapore-2 and zurich-1 starting 2026-07-15 02:00 UTC. This is PREVIEW only 12 do NOT move production workloads yet. Reservation guidance below. :rocket:

raj-eng: Specs? memory / NVLink / perf delta vs L40s?

emma-ops: Polaris P850: 128GB VRAM, NVLink2, sequence-optimized tensor cores. Early internal perf: ~2.1x L40s on long-context FP16 tests; numbers preliminary. We'll publish detailed perf pack after the first validation wave.

ops-bot: System notice: pools/polaris-p850 labelled "preview-rotational". Warm-window default = 60m. Preemptible cap = 20% of pool. Placement priority: reserved contracts > committed buckets > warm reservations > ad-hoc.

raj-eng: Any reservation semantic changes for preview pools?

emma-ops: A couple of policy notes: 1) --priority high does NOT guarantee placement on preview pools, 2) warm-window can be extended per-reservation but requires justification in meta; abuse will be rate-limited.

maria-sre: Infra note: Polaris racks have a clustered cooling dependency in zrh racks. If you see coolant alarms tag @maria-sre and escalate to #eng-oncall. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/polaris-p850 (internal).

oliver-product: Billing tag & experiment tracking?

emma-ops: Use charge tag: polaris-preview-jul2026 in reservation meta. Console filters for this tag will be available by EOD.

emma-ops: CLI example (copy/paste):
```
# reserve 1 GPU in polaris-p850 pool in singapore-2 for 90 minutes starting 2026-07-15T02:00Z
rdrctl reserve --pool polaris-p850 --region singapore-2 --count 1 --start 2026-07-15T02:00Z --duration 90m --meta "charge=polaris-preview-jul2026"
```

raj-eng: reserving one for decoder-only sanity tests.

ops-bot: Reservation confirmed (id: 51802) for raj-eng 12 pool: polaris-p850, region: singapore-2, start: 2026-07-15T02:00Z, duration: 90m.

compliance-bot: Reminder: preview pools are NOT cleared for regulated customer data. Do not process PHI/PCI until compliance sign-off.

maria-sre: Firmware pinned to p850-fw-3.4.0 for preview. Do not apply upgrades during the validation window without coordination.

jess-ps: Partner note: we'll invite a small set of partners to opt into the preview tomorrow; partner guide coming with opt-in instructions.

emma-ops: Policy tweak (effective immediately for preview pools): warm-window default reduced from 90m to 60m to improve fairness across regions. If you need more time include --duration override and add a short justification to --meta.

raj-eng: saw slightly higher p99 on long-context runs vs devbench, posting traces to #eng-runtime.

emma-ops: Thanks 12 if anyone sees infra anomalies open a ticket with label "polaris-p850-preview" and tag @maria-sre. We'll pause the window if needed. :eyes:
